Team — I reviewed the MSA redlines Rafael referenced. High-level notes:

- Section 6 (Data Processing): redline is acceptable except we need to confirm customer-required data retention settings in the Console. Kim, can you confirm whether MedOps needs logs retained longer than our standard 90 days?
- Section 10 (Indemnity): proposed cap still oversized for a startup; propose mutual cap at $1M except for gross negligence.
- Order Form: we need explicit PO number mapping field and a contractual reference that PO issuance does not broaden scope beyond the signed order form. Add a PO routing appendix so Coupa exports include the required header fields.

Coupa/PO operational asks for MedOps:
- Provide Coupa account ID and sample PO XML or CSV (header + line schema).
- SFTP: If you share host and test credentials, we'll run an initial PO push through our staging pipeline and confirm field mapping. Otherwise provide API spec (we support basic SFTP/FTPS and REST push with JSON).

Attachments: Redline_MSA_MedOps_20270912.docx (redline with tracked changes)

Next steps: once we have the sample PO and SFTP details, Ops (Marissa) will schedule a test and Legal will prepare a slim redline to present to MedOps. Target: legal sign-off by 2027-09-17.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks for the quick review. Answers below and attached sample PO export.

- Retention: we require transaction-level logs for 365 days; can you confirm an SLA for log retention if needed?
- PO sample: see attached sample_po_header.xml and coupa_field_mapping.csv (attached). Our PO header fields: PO_NUMBER, PO_DATE, COST_CENTER, TAX_CODE, SHIP_TO_LOCATION.
- SFTP: host sftp.medops.com (test). Credentials to follow from our SFTP admin (separate secure email). We also support REST POST to /v1/po if you prefer JSON payloads.

We'll accept the proposed mutual cap at $1M provided exceptions for regulatory liabilities are preserved. On the PO appendix, procurement wants the mapping to be contractual so downstream systems don't reject valid invoices.

Attachments: sample_po_header.xml (xml), coupa_field_mapping.csv (csv)

Happy to join Thu 9/13 10am PT if that's when you run the working session.

— Jane
